name: DescriptorCounts
signature: public readonly record struct DescriptorCounts(uint Samplers, uint UniformBuffers, uint UniformBuffersDynamic, uint StorageBuffers, uint SampledImages, uint StorageImages, uint Resources)

docs.summary: Descriptors of each kind, as a pipeline layout holds them or as a device limits them.

params.Samplers: Samplers, including the sampler half of combined image samplers.
params.UniformBuffersDynamic: Uniform buffers with a dynamic offset, which every Graphite uniform buffer is.
params.SampledImages: Read only textures, including the image half of combined image samplers.
